This is a flag-design pair with a point of view: black leather, a metallic gold cuff, a bear graphic and a tricolor flag palm. It is made for fighters who want identity on their hands, and the contrast between the dark body and the bright palm panels makes it easy to recognize in the gym.

Choosing a weight

Use 6oz-10oz for speed and pad work, 12oz-14oz for bag and general training, and 16oz-18oz for sparring. If you are between sizes, go heavier for sparring and lighter for pads.

Lace-Up or Velcro?

Lace-Up gives the firmest, flattest wrist wrap and suits sparring. Velcro lets you glove up alone in seconds and suits solo bag work.

Care

Keep the metallic gold cuff dry and wipe the gloves with a soft cloth after sessions. Air-dry them open and store them out of direct sun.

g.descriptionHtml:
No Boxing No Life (NBNL) boxing gloves are made for boxers who want their gloves to look as good as they train. This collection holds 22 designs, from bear-graphic editions to metallic fight-night pairs. Most come in every size from 6oz to 18oz with a choice of Lace-Up or Velcro closure, and we ship across the USA, the UK, Europe and Canada.

Shop NBNL gloves by design

  • Bear editions: Maroon & Lime Green, Blue & Silver, Black & Yellow, Yellow & Metallic Red, Flag Design Black & Gold
  • Metallic finishes: Metallic Red & Gold, Metallic Pink & Silver, Black & Metallic Gold, Emerald Green & Gold, Rose Gold & White, Neon Yellow & Metallic Blue
  • Classic two-tone: Red & Black, Red & White, White & Black, Black & Gold, White & Gold, White & Brown Vintage, Forest Green, White & Gold
  • Pro line: Pro Green & Gold, Pro Blue & Black
  • Lace-up only, long cuff: Black & Silver, Multi-Cross White

Which size NBNL glove do I need?

  • 6oz-10oz: speed, pad and mitt work, and smaller hands
  • 12oz-14oz: heavy bag and general training, and the best first pair for most beginners
  • 16oz: the standard adult sparring weight in most US and UK gyms
  • 18oz: sparring for heavier boxers, or extra protection for a training partner

Lace-Up or Velcro?

Lace-Up wraps the wrist tightest and suits sparring and coached sessions. Velcro (hook and loop) lets you glove up alone in seconds and suits solo bag work and classes. The Black & Silver and Multi-Cross White models are lace-up only.

Caring for metallic and light-colored gloves

Wipe metallic finishes with a soft dry cloth, not water. Wipe white and light leather after every session. Air-dry gloves open and store them out of direct sun to protect the color.

Want gloves, headguard and groin protector in one colorway? Shop No Boxing No Life sparring sets.

No Boxing No Life Boxing Gloves FAQ

What does NBNL stand for?

NBNL is short for No Boxing No Life, a boxing glove brand known for bold colorways, metallic finishes and bear-graphic designs.

Which NBNL glove is best for a beginner?

A 12oz or 14oz pair in a darker colorway such as Red & Black or Black & Gold. It hides wear and covers bag and pad work; add a 16oz pair when you start sparring.

Do you ship NBNL gloves to the USA, UK, Europe and Canada?

Yes. Shipping costs and delivery times for your country are shown at checkout before you pay.

Are NBNL metallic gloves only for show?

No. Metallic pairs train like any other NBNL glove. The finish just needs a dry cloth rather than water to keep its shine.

How do I tell the bear editions apart?

They share the NBNL bear graphic in different colors: Maroon & Lime Green and Yellow & Metallic Red are the warm pairs, Blue & Silver is the cool pair, and Black & Yellow is the high-contrast dark pair.

s.descriptionHtml:
No Boxing No Life (NBNL) sparring sets put boxing gloves, headgear and protection in one matching colorway, so your whole kit arrives together and looks like it belongs together. Choose from 14 sets with lace-up gloves from 6oz to 18oz, shipped to the USA, the UK, Europe and Canada.

Shop NBNL sets by style

  • Metallic sets: Metallic Red & Gold, Metallic Pink & White, Metallic Gold & Black, Metallic Blue & Black, Metallic Purple & White
  • Red & black, three headgear options: Open-face headgear, Elite with face guard, Dual headgear
  • Two-tone and split designs: Purple & Black, Blue & Gold, Half Black & White, Half Black & Silver
  • Solid and high-visibility: Matte Black, Yellow & Black

Open-face, face guard or face bar?

  • Open-face cheek protection: the widest field of vision, good for technical sparring
  • Face guard (Elite): more facial cover with a light feel
  • Face bar: the most protection for hard rounds and newer sparrers

The Red & Black Dual Headgear set includes both an open cheek-protection headguard and a face-bar headguard. Check each listing for exactly what is included.

Choosing the glove weight in your set

Most adults spar in 16oz gloves; boxers over about 200 lb (90 kg) often choose 18oz. Lighter weights from 6oz to 14oz suit youth boxers, pad work and bag training.

Need gloves only? Browse No Boxing No Life boxing gloves.

No Boxing No Life Sparring Sets FAQ

What comes in an NBNL sparring set?

Each set pairs lace-up gloves with matching headgear, and most add a matching groin protector. The Dual Headgear set swaps the groin protector for a second headguard.

Why buy a set instead of separate pieces?

You get gloves, headgear and protection in one coordinated colorway without matching shades piece by piece, and the whole kit arrives in one order.

Which NBNL set is best for a first sparring kit?

Matte Black or Purple & Black. Both hide wear, and with 16oz gloves they cover most adult sparring.

Which red and black set should I buy?

Pick the standard set for open-face headgear, the Elite for a face guard, or the Dual Headgear set if you want both styles.

How do I size the headgear?

Measure around your head just above the eyebrows. If you are between sizes, contact us before ordering so we can confirm the fit.
